  • The first position of each row (the one of the left) is position number [MATH: 0.]

[MATH: ((0)/(0)); ((1)/(0))|((1)/(1)); ((2)/(0))|((2)/(1))|((2)/(2)); ((3)/(0))|((3)/(1))|((3)/(2))|((3)/(3)); ((4)/(0))|((4)/(1))|((4)/(2))|(4 3)|((4)/(4)); ⋮|⋮|⋮|⋮|⋮|⋮]

Now, [MATH: \displaystyle{4 \choose 3}] is the sum of the two closest numbers located in the previous row. So [MATH: \displaystyle{4 \choose 3} = \displaystyle{3 \choose 2} + \displaystyle{3 \choose 3}.]

Therefore, the missing expression is [MATH: \displaystyle{3 \choose 3}.]

Suppose that we wanted to calculate the value of [MATH: \displaystyle{30 \choose 3}.] If we were to use Pascal's triangle, we'd have to write out [MATH: 31] rows, which would take a long time. Thankfully, there is a formula for calculating binomial coefficients.

Content:
The binomial coefficient [MATH: \displaystyle{n \choose r}] is given by the formula
[MATH: \displaystyle{n \choose r} = \dfrac{n!}{(n-r)!\, r!}.]

items.title: Calculating Binomial Coefficients Using the Formula

sections.normalized_html:
The binomial coefficient [MATH: \displaystyle{n \choose r}] is given by the formula [MATH: \displaystyle{n \choose r} = \dfrac{n!}{(n-r)!\, r!}.]

In this case, we have [MATH: n = 5] and [MATH: r = 4.] Therefore, [MATH: ((5)/(4))|= (5!)/((5 − 4)! ⋅ 4!); = (5 ⋅ 4!)/(1! ⋅ 4!); = (5 ⋅ 4!)/(1 ⋅ 4!); = 5.]

[MATH: ((0)/(0)); ((1)/(0))|((1)/(1)); ((2)/(0))|((2)/(1))|((2)/(2)); ((3)/(0))|((3)/(1))|((3)/(2))|((3)/(3)); ((4)/(0))|((4)/(1))|((4)/(2))|(4 3)|((4)/(4)); ⋮|⋮|⋮|⋮|⋮|⋮]

Item 8 — Tutorial: A Formula for the Binomial Coefficients

Content:
Suppose that we wanted to calculate the value of [MATH: \displaystyle{30 \choose 3}.] If we were to use Pascal's triangle, we'd have to write out [MATH: 31] rows, which would take a long time. Thankfully, there is a formula for calculating binomial coefficients.

Content:
The binomial coefficient [MATH: \displaystyle{n \choose r}] is given by the formula
[MATH: \displaystyle{n \choose r} = \dfrac{n!}{(n-r)!\, r!}.]

---

Item 9 — Example: Calculating Binomial Coefficients Using the Formula

Example Prompt:
Determine the value of [MATH: \displaystyle{5 \choose 4}.]

Content:
EXPLANATION

Explanation:
The binomial coefficient [MATH: \displaystyle{n \choose r}] is given by the formula
[MATH: \displaystyle{n \choose r} = \dfrac{n!}{(n-r)!\, r!}.]

[MATH: ((5)/(4))|= (5!)/((5 − 4)! ⋅ 4!); = (5 ⋅ 4!)/(1! ⋅ 4!); = (5 ⋅ 4!)/(1 ⋅ 4!); = 5.]
